records.source_span: Lily's robotics club at school meets every other Friday, specifically the first and third Fridays of each month, from 3:15 to 4:30 PM. This started around early March as a trial program at her school.
records.claim: Lily's robotics club meets on the first and third Fridays of each month from 3:15 to 4:30 PM, starting in early March.

records.source_span: Lily's swimming lessons are at the Greenfield Aquatic Center every Tuesday and Thursday, 4:30 to 5:15 PM, with Coach Rivera in the intermediate lane. Those started back in mid-January and they've been going great.
records.value: Tuesday and Thursday, 4:30–5:15 PM, Greenfield Aquatic Center, Coach Rivera, intermediate lane
records.claim: Lily has swimming lessons at Greenfield Aquatic Center every Tuesday and Thursday from 4:30 to 5:15 PM with Coach Rivera in the intermediate lane, starting in mid-January.

records.source_span: I double-checked with the school office and the robotics club actually meets on the second and fourth Fridays, not the first and third like I originally said. Same time, 3:15 to 4:30 PM, but it's definitely the second and fourth Fridays each month.
records.claim: Lily's robotics club meets on the second and fourth Fridays of each month from 3:15 to 4:30 PM.

records.source_span: She also has a Saturday morning art class at Creative Sparks studio on Elm Street, 10 AM to 11:30 AM every Saturday. She's been doing that since late January. She really loves the watercolor work they do there.
records.value: Saturday, 10:00–11:30 AM, Creative Sparks studio, Elm Street, watercolor focus
records.claim: Lily has an art class at Creative Sparks studio on Elm Street every Saturday from 10:00 to 11:30 AM, focusing on watercolor, starting in late January.

records.source_span: Funny coincidence — my niece Ava does robotics at her school on the second and fourth Fridays, 3:30–4:45 PM.
records.claim: Ava does robotics at her school on the second and fourth Fridays from 3:30 to 4:45 PM.

records.source_span: the swim center sent an email that starting April 1st, the Tuesday swimming slot moves to 5:00 to 5:45 PM. Thursday stays the same at 4:30 to 5:15 PM.
records.value: Tuesday 5:00–5:45 PM, Thursday 4:30–5:15 PM, Greenfield Aquatic Center, Coach Rivera, intermediate lane
records.claim: Starting April 1st, Lily's swimming schedule changes to Tuesday 5:00–5:45 PM and Thursday 4:30–5:15 PM at Greenfield Aquatic Center with Coach Rivera.

records.source_span: starting in April the robotics club is switching to every Friday instead of every other Friday, same time slot 3:15 to 4:30. Apparently the trial was popular enough that they're expanding it.
records.claim: Starting in April, Lily's robotics club meets every Friday from 3:15 to 4:30 PM instead of every other Friday.

records.source_span: We actually dropped Lily's Wednesday piano lessons with Mrs. Chen at the end of February. She just wasn't connecting with it, and those evenings were so rushed and stressful for everyone.
records.claim: Lily's piano lessons with Mrs. Chen were discontinued at the end of February because she was not connecting with the activity and the schedule was stressful.

records.source_span: There's a youth climbing program at Summit Gym starting in April on Saturday afternoons. I like that it's individual and not team-based. I haven't signed her up yet, but I'm seriously considering it.
records.value: potential, Summit Gym, Saturday afternoons, starting April
records.claim: Lily may join a youth rock climbing program at Summit Gym on Saturday afternoons starting in April, but has not yet been enrolled.

records.source_span: the robotics coach sent a note home saying they're looking at moving the club to Wednesdays 3:15 to 4:30 starting in May because of gym scheduling conflicts on Fridays. Nothing is confirmed yet, they're still figuring it out with administration.
records.value: potential move to Wednesday 3:15–4:30 PM in May
records.claim: The robotics coach indicated a potential move of the club to Wednesdays 3:15–4:30 PM starting in May due to gym scheduling conflicts, but this is not yet confirmed.
records.condition: not yet confirmed; pending administration approval

records.source_span: Lily's spring art show at Creative Sparks is coming up on April 19th. She's been working on a big watercolor piece for it.
records.claim: Lily has a spring art show at Creative Sparks on April 19th where she will display a watercolor piece she has been working on.

records.source_span: I was talking to my neighbor Karen about her son Ethan's after-school activities. Ethan's robotics club at Westfield Elementary meets on the first and third Fridays, 3:00–4:15 PM.
records.value: first and third Fridays, 3:00–4:15 PM, Westfield Elementary
records.claim: Ethan's robotics club at Westfield Elementary meets on the first and third Fridays from 3:00 to 4:15 PM.

records.source_span: Sometimes I miss the weeks when Lily didn't have robotics on Friday — we used to go get ice cream on those off Fridays. Now that it's every week, we've lost that little tradition.

records.source_span: I keep worrying about what happens if the school changes robotics to a different day. What days would be the worst for us?
records.claim: Lily has swimming on Tuesday and Thursday.

records.source_span: For example, if it were something like first and third Thursdays, 3:15–4:30 PM, that would conflict with swimming at 4:30 PM since you'd barely have time to get from school to the aquatic center.
